reference: Fixed drag_center in hull frame; positive diagonal fluid inertia, skew-symmetric Coriolis coupling; force-level one-step partitioned integration
basis: 70/250/250 kg corresponds to 0.07/0.25/0.25 m3 of entrained fresh water. Lower longitudinal inertia reflects slender hull; these are conservative trial values, not strip-theory or measured results. Rotational radii sqrt(J/M) approximately 0.35 m roll and 0.89 m pitch/yaw. Sweep 0/0.5/1/2 times these coefficients; do not copy WAM-V coefficients.
limitations: One-step acceleration coupling, diagonal constant matrix; no radiation memory, frequency dependence or full fluid solver. Validate timestep convergence and maneuvering before accepting configuration. Added mass does not add weight or change fuel mass.
